act.long_title: An Act to consolidate and to provide for general rules and principles of evidence for fair trial.

section.heading: Accomplice
section.html: An accomplice shall be a competent witness against an accused person; and a conviction is not illegal if it proceeds upon the corroborated testimony of an accomplice.
section.text: An accomplice shall be a competent witness against an accused person; and a conviction is not illegal if it proceeds upon the corroborated testimony of an accomplice.
